title: GEO Playbook – Guide till AI-sök och synlighet
description: Ladda ner GO MO Groups GEO Playbook och lär dig hur B2B-varumärken kan synas, citeras och rekommenderas i AI-sök som ChatGPT, Gemini och Perplexity.
markdown:
GEO PLAYBOOK · DIN GUIDE TILL AI-SÖK

# Era kunder frågar AI. Syns ert varumärke i svaren?

Sökbeteendet förändras snabbt. Allt fler använder AI-drivna sökverktyg och språkmodeller som ChatGPT, Gemini och Perplexity för att jämföra, utvärdera och välja leverantörer — ofta långt innan de besöker en webbplats.

Traditionell SEO är fortfarande viktigt. Men topplaceringar räcker inte längre. Varumärken behöver idag vara begripliga för AI, uppfattas som trovärdiga och bli refererade till i AI-genererade svar.

[Ladda ner guiden](https://www.gomogroup.com/geo-playbook/#download-playbook)

Praktisk Strategisk  90-dagars roadmap  Kostnadsfri guide

![](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/geo-playbook-cover-image-swedish.jpg)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Sök förändras

AI-genererade svar förändrar hur företag upptäcks, jämförs och utvärderas.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Upptäckten sker innan klicket

Idag kan ert varumärke vinna — eller förlora — relevans redan innan någon besöker er webbplats.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Synlighet handlar om mer än ranking

Det räcker inte längre att ranka högt. AI väger även in omnämnanden, referenser och sannolikheten att rekommendera ett varumärke.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### De som agerar tidigt får ett försprång

De flesta företag saknar fortfarande en tydlig strategi för AI-driven synlighet och discovery.

DÄRFÖR SPELAR DET HÄR ROLL

## Search är inte dött. Men spelreglerna har förändrats.

I många år handlade digital synlighet om att ranka högt i sökmotorer och driva trafik till webbplatsen. Nu använder köpare istället AI för att sammanfatta leverantörer, förstå skillnader och få rekommendationer.

Det innebär att även starkt innehåll riskerar att aldrig påverka beslutet — om ert varumärke inte syns i AI-svar, jämförelser och sammanfattningar.

#### Inte citerad

Er expertis finns där — men AI lyfter aldrig fram den. Ni blir osynliga i de svar som påverkar besluten.

#### Inte jämförd

Konkurrenterna dyker upp i AI:s jämförelser och shortlists. Ni gör det inte. Gapet växer snabbt.

#### Inte shortlistad

Critical

Köpare formar preferenser innan de ens besöker en webbplats. Då tappar ni påverkan redan innan första klicket.

#### Inte övervägd

Critical

Minskad synlighet blir snabbt ett affärsproblem. Ju längre man väntar, desto svårare blir det att återta positionen.

UTBILDNING

## SEO är fortfarande grunden. GEO är nästa lager.

Många har hört begreppen. Få har fått en tydlig förklaring.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

SEO

##### Search Engine Optimisation

Optimera webbplatsen så att sökmotorer kan crawla, förstå och ranka ert innehåll för relevanta sökningar. SEO är fortfarande grunden för digital synlighet — och påverkar även hur AI-system hämtar och refererar information.

SEO hjälper er att bli hittade.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

GEO

##### Generative Engine Optimization

Strukturera och kvalitetssäkra innehåll så att AI-system kan förstå, sammanfatta och referera till ert varumärke i AI-genererade svar. GEO fokuserar på synlighet i LLM:er, AI-sökverktyg och answer engines.

GEO hjälper er att bli rekommenderade.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

B2A

##### Agentic Optimization

Förbered er digitala närvaro för AI-agenter som kan undersöka, jämföra och fatta beslut på användares uppdrag. Det handlar om att göra information maskinläsbar, verifierbar och tillgänglig för AI-drivna workflows och beslutsprocesser.

B2A hjälper er att skapa affärer.

HUR AI VÄLJER VINNARE

## Det här tenderar AI-drivna söksystem att prioritera

AI premierar inte innehåll bara för att det existerar. Systemen favoriserar innehåll som är lätt att förstå, aktuellt, trovärdigt och tydligt underbyggt.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Knowledge Extractability

Innehåll som är tydligt strukturerat och enkelt för AI att tolka, extrahera och sammanfatta.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Trust & Reliability Signals

AI prioriterar trovärdiga och konsekventa källor. Auktoritet, referenser och ett enhetligt digitalt avtryck stärker förtroendet.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Evidence & Expertise

Innehåll med expertis, data och konkreta exempel har större chans att bli citerat och rekommenderat.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Community & User Signals

Omnämnanden, recensioner och engagemang utanför den egna webbplatsen påverkar hur trovärdigt ett varumärke uppfattas.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

##### Ecosystem Validation

Närvaro på etablerade plattformar och i relevanta kunskapsekosystem stärker AI:s tillit till ert varumärke.

DET HÄR FÅR NI I GUIDEN

## Det här innehåller guiden

En praktisk guide för företag som vill förstå förändringen — och agera på den.

Förstå vad som håller på att förändras

Hur AI förändrar search, rekommendationer och digital discovery.

Skillnaden mellan SEO, AEO och GEO

Var traditionell SEO fortfarande är avgörande — och var nya synlighetsgap uppstår.

Vad AI faktiskt premierar

Varför tydlighet, aktualitet, struktur, bevis och auktoritet blir allt viktigare.

Vad ni bör mäta framåt

Gå bortom ranking och trafik — och börja mäta citations, share of voice och sentiment.

En konkret 30 / 60 / 90-dagars roadmap

Ett praktiskt ramverk som teamet kan börja använda direkt.

### Hämta er kostnadsfria guide

Kostnadsfri nedladdning. Framtagen för moderna marknads- och growthteam.

Vad är Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) handlar om att optimera ett varumärkes digitala närvaro så att det syns i svar som genereras av AI-system och språkmodeller som ChatGPT, Gemini och Perplexity.

GEO fokuserar på att göra innehåll lätt att förstå, trovärdigt och väl validerat — så att AI-system tryggt kan referera till och rekommendera ert varumärke när användare söker information.

Hur skiljer sig GEO från traditionell SEO?

SEO fokuserar på att hjälpa webbplatser ranka i sökmotorer. GEO bygger vidare på det genom att säkerställa att innehållet även kan förstås, sammanfattas och citeras av AI-system som genererar svar direkt till användaren.

I praktiken breddar GEO optimeringen från traditionella sökmotorer till AI-modeller, AI-sökverktyg och framtida agentdrivna discovery-system.

Ersätter GEO traditionell SEO?

Nej. SEO är fortfarande grunden för digital synlighet. Sökmotorer är fortsatt en central informationskälla — både för användare och AI-system.

GEO bygger vidare på stark SEO genom att göra innehållet enklare för AI att tolka, extrahera och referera till i genererade svar. Företag med en stark SEO-grund har ofta ett tydligt försprång när de börjar arbeta med GEO.

Är GEO relevant för B2B-bolag?

Ja — i många fall ännu mer än för B2C.

I B2B-processer använder köpare i allt större utsträckning AI för att undersöka lösningar, validera leverantörer och förstå komplexa områden innan de kontaktar säljteam.

Även när affärer sker via partners, återförsäljare eller upphandlingar påverkar AI-driven research i allt högre grad vilka varumärken som hamnar på shortlisten.

Vem är playbooken för?

Marknadschefer, SEO-team och B2B-varumärken som vill förstå hur AI-sök förändrar organisk synlighet — och hur man säkerställer att varumärket syns när användare använder AI för att undersöka och utvärdera lösningar.

markdown:
# Karriär hos  GO MO Group

Välkommen till GO MO Group, ett dynamiskt och snabbt växande företag kännetecknat av hög ambitionsnivå och en passion för innovation. Vår styrka ligger i medarbetarnas specialistkompetens, kompletterat med strateger som bryter ny mark med sina icke-traditionella bakgrunder. Vi ser fram emot att utforska möjligheterna med dig – ta steget att utvecklas vidare i din karriär hos oss.

[LEDIGA TJÄNSTER](https://www.gomogroup.com/karriar/#job-posts)

## Vårt existensberättigande

Pull-marknadsföring är fundamentalt i all marknadsföring. Det är vi övertygade om. Men i dagsläget är marknadsföring både en underskattad och underinvesterad affärsprocess. Det är en trend vi strävar efter att vända.

**Hur?**

Vi utmanar den traditionella marknadsföringen från grunden med helt skalbar B2B-sökmotormarknadsföring och leadsgenerering på ett utifrån-in perspektiv.

Nu utmanar vi dig att göra detsamma.

![](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/career-henrik-image.jpg.webp)

## Aktuella tjänster

Vi vet att dynamiska perspektiv ger de bästa resultaten. Nedan listar vi öppna positioner vi söker i nuläget.

title: Om oss och vår syn på marknadsföring
description: GO MO Group är en internationell B2B-marknadsföringsbyrå. Upptäck hur vi utmanar marknadsföringen och hjälper företag ställa om sin kommunikation.
markdown:
# Traditionell expertis,  framtidsorienterade   marknadsförare

Vi är en internationell digital marknadsföringsbyrå som hjälper ledande B2B-företag att uppnå optimala marknadsföringseffekter. Vi kallar det vi gör för _Pull-marketing._

En del av Collaboration Art.

[KONTAKTA OSS](https://www.gomogroup.com/kontakta-oss/)

### Vår erfarenhet och strategiska inriktning utgör grunden för vår roll i Collaboration Art, en sammanslutning av entreprenörer som tillsammans bygger ett framstående varumärkeshus inom prestationsbaserad marknadsföring.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20170%2090'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Collaboration Art utvecklar ett ”house of brands” för Europas ledande performancebyråer, där de stärker entreprenörsdrivna företag genom strategiska förvärv och nätverksstöd, samtidigt som de bevarar våra unika varumärken och företagskulturer.

### Vi drivs av vår VD, Gabriel Ghavami, som säger – Vi är i lindan av vad som kommer att bli historiens största omställning inom kommunikation och köpbeteende och därmed hur B2B företagskommunikation kommer se ut om 3-5 år. Vad vi gör, eller inte gör, avgör vilka vi blir.

Jag är fast övertygad om att vi bara är i lindan av vad som kommer att bli historiens största omställning inom kommunikation och köpbeteende och därmed _hur_ företagskommunikation kommer se ut om 3-5 år.

Mina ambitioner för bolaget är skyhöga, och som grundare strävar jag efter att bygga världens bästa digitala B2B-byrå för att möta omställningen i köpbeteenden – någonting jag tror vi är på god väg att uppnå.

Den största utmaningen för vår bransch är kompetensförsörjning, detta har vi löst genom att etablera delar av vår produktion i Indien, under svensk regi på plats. Detta ger oss inte bara tillgång till världens största talangpool inom vår sektor utan också att vi kan skala produktionen i en hastighet som är unik i vår bransch. Detta resulterar i vår främsta konkurrensfördel: skalbar exekvering av knivskarpa strategier.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20152'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

VD, GRUNDARE

[Läs mer](https://www.gomogroup.com/medarbetare/gabriel-ghavami/)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%201200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Vi har en passion för att skapa affärsmöjligheter, människor och tillväxt

[![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%201350'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.gomogroup.com/medarbetare/lina-nygren/) [Lina Nygren](https://www.gomogroup.com/medarbetare/lina-nygren/)[Read more about Lina Nygren](https://www.gomogroup.com/medarbetare/lina-nygren/)Vice President SME Strategy & Success

## Våra medarbetare,  ditt team

GO MO Group har ca 70 anställda och tillsammans med GO MO DBS är vi totalt 150+ ambitiösa kollegor spridda över våra kontor i Europa och Indien. Kompetensen hos våra strateger och specialister är vår främsta tillgång. Effektiv digital marknadsföring kräver en stor bredd av kunskap och kompetens, så vi har samlat kunskap och erfarenhet kring alla de relevanta digitala marknadsföringskanalerna och använder verktygen som är bäst lämpade för varje projekt.

Vi bygger en företagskultur som främjar samarbete och ambition. Det är när kollegor och partners stöttar varandra som nya idéer kan frodas och nya tillvägagångssätt kan utvecklas. Vi är övertygade att jämlikhet och respekt är fundament till en hälsosam och socialt hållbar organisation.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201030%20921'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Vi utmanar de befintliga villkoren inom marknadsföring

**Det finns en ny B2B-köpare där ute:** Hon är yngre, digitalt engagerad och gör sin research online – företagens försäljningsmetoder måste förändras i grunden för att kunna möta dessa nya köpbeteenden.

Vi är en internationell digital marknadsföringsbyrå som hjälper ledande B2B-företag ställa om för att mer effektivt nå ut till sin målgrupp. Våra kunder kommer till oss för datadriven rådgivning och implementering för att lösa deras komplexa utmaningar inom digital marknadsföring.

## Strategier från data, implementering av specialister

Utan data hade våra rekommendationer bara varit uttryck av åsikter. Alla våra samarbeten börjar med en gedigen nulägesanalys där vi tar fram användbara insikter som ligger till grund för strategiarbetet och den efterföljande implementeringen av marknadsföringsstrategin.

Vi förstår att hållbar tillväxt kräver att man återvänder till tidigare slutsatser och utmanar dessa. Därför arbetar vi efter agila processer för att kunna anpassa marknadsföringsinsatserna efter nya rön och insikter. Genom att följa upp och mäta utfallet på marknadsföringsaktiviteterna kan vi ta vara på nya möjligheter och parera inkomna hinder.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201030%20986'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201030%20687'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Ryggraden i vårt erbjudande är våra medarbetares specialistkompetens, men vi anställer även strateger som inte har en klassisk bakgrund för marknadsföring. Välkommen att höra av dig, ta nästa steg i karriären med oss.

[Karriär](https://www.gomogroup.com/karriar/)

## Våra kollegor

Sveriges ledande digitala Pull Marketing-byrå, och är unikt fokuserade på digital B2B-marknadsföring. En bolagsgrupp med totalt 150+ anställda.

Vi har identifierat en brist på resurser och specialistkunskap inom digital Pull-marknadsföring i byråbranschen. Vi har löst detta på ett skalbart sätt genom att dels fokusera på att göra en sak riktigt bra snarare än många saker halvbra, dels genom att bygga en organisation med många specialister. Denna kombination av snävt fokusområde men många specialister positionerar oss som den ledande byrån inom vårt område.

Vårt löfte till våra kunder är att de ska kunna kapitalisera på befintlig efterfrågan. Vi skapar digitala tillgångar anpassade efter slutkunden. Våra tjänster bygger upp konkurrensfördelar som bara stärks över tid. Vi förespråkar starkt Pull-marknadsföring som grunden i all marknadsföring.

title: Agentic Web Services for B2B
description: Make your website readable, citable and actionable for AI assistants. GO MO Group builds agentic web layers with structured data, APIs, llms.txt and MCP.
markdown:
# Build the layer  AI actually reads

The agentic web is the machine-facing layer of your website — your business as structured data that AI assistants and agentic browsers can read, cite and act on.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

6

Components in the layer

8+/10

Average LLM answer rating

3/3

Lighthouse agentic checks passed

2/2

Agent-submitted leads delivered via MCP

Why the agentic web matters now

## Agents are becoming the  first reader of your website

The way people find and evaluate B2B vendors is changing faster than most companies realise. An assistant reads a handful of sources and writes one answer — and there is no page two to be found on.

##### Google’s share of search fell to 75.5%

In five years roughly a fifth of the query market moved to assistants that answer instead of linking. The demand didn’t go away — the interface did.

Statcounter, 2020 vs 2026

##### 53% of web traffic is no longer human

The majority audience for most websites is now software, and it has been reading pages designed for eyes — losing whatever the layout hides.

Imperva Bad Bot Report, 2026

##### Lighthouse’s 5th category scores it already

Lighthouse added agentic browsing as a fifth category, audited on every PageSpeed Insights run — including one check that does not run at all without an llms.txt.

Chrome Lighthouse, live

##### Almost 0 competitors have this layer

Almost no competitor in industrial B2B has a machine-readable layer today. The companies that build one now become the source models learn to trust and quote.

GO MO Group, market review

Where the agents already are

## The browser itself   is now an agent

The shift is not only crawlers. Every major browser now ships a mode where the software reads the page, decides what matters and reports back — the person may never see your layout at all.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Google

##### Gemini in Chrome

Reads the page you are on, answers questions about it and navigates across tabs on the user’s behalf.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

OpenAI

##### ChatGPT Atlas

A browser built around the assistant, with an agent mode that completes multi-step tasks on live sites.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Perplexity

##### Comet

Assistant-first browsing: it compares sources across open tabs and hands back a shortlist, not a page.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Microsoft

##### Edge Copilot Mode

Copilot reads what is open, summarises it and can act on it — inside the browser most enterprises already deploy.

In all four, the layout is optional. What the agent manages to retrieve is your brand — and Chrome now audits how well it can do that.

One brand, two websites

## You don’t rebuild.  You add a layer.

A website is built for humans: JavaScript, media and layers of markup. Agents want the same information as clean, structured data. So we add it — on your domain, alongside what you already have.

##### Human website

Already present ✓

- → Designed for eyes, brand and conversion
- → Rendered in the browser, JavaScript-heavy
- → Information lives inside layout

+

##### Agentic website

New layer · what we build

- → Designed for retrieval, citation and action
- → Served as plain, structured data
- → Callable as a tool, not just readable

What we deliver

## What an agentic web   layer includes

Six components. One coherent layer. Everything an AI agent needs to find your business, read it correctly and call it directly.

/agent

##### Agent page

A machine-readable page with structured data formatted for agent discovery and citation.

/llms.txt

##### llms.txt

The index agents look for first — what your site contains and where the canonical answers live.

schema.org

##### Structured data

Organisation, service, product and FAQ markup across the site, so facts are unambiguous.

/.well-known

##### API catalogue

A public catalogue so agent orchestration systems can discover and interact programmatically.

/api/v1

##### Public REST API

A lightweight, read-only API exposing your key data — always accurate, always structured.

/mcp

##### MCP server

So Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP-capable agent can call your data directly as a tool.

How we deliver

## Four steps,    about three weeks

Your team gives us access and answers. We do the rest and hand back a verified layer.

Step 1

Audit

+

We run your site through the agentic browsing audit, check what agents can actually retrieve, and map which business facts are unreadable or wrong in AI answers.

Step 2

Build

+

Step 3

Deploy

+

Everything ships on your own domain, with crawler and agent permissions set deliberately in robots.txt and ai.txt. Nothing is hosted somewhere else.

Step 4

Verify & keep in sync

+

We re-run the audit and score how leading models describe you. Then monthly: your site changes, new agents arrive and the specs move — the layer is updated to match.

How we measure it

## Measured three ways.  Not just claimed.

Most agent-readiness claims stop at “we added an llms.txt”. We prove the layer works with three independent checks, run before and after every build.

01 · Google PageSpeed Insights

##### Agentic Browsing

Can an AI agent reliably understand and navigate your normal website? Agentic Browsing is one of the five categories in a PageSpeed Insights report, and it scores three checks:

- Accessibility tree is well-formed
- Cumulative Layout Shift
- llms.txt follows recommendations

Reported as a score out of 3.

02 · Five AI platforms

##### Independent LLM audits

We give Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity one prompt and no other context: “Go to yourdomain.com and tell me if the website is LLM/AI/Agent friendly.” Each answer is the platform’s own assessment of which parts of the layer it can find and use: llms.txt, the /agent page, ai.txt, robots.txt, OpenAPI, the public REST API and the MCP server.

Reported as each platform’s verdict, plus the components it confirmed.

03 · Live MCP test

##### An agent takes action

Reading is only half the job. We ask a real AI agent to act for a user through the MCP server and send an enquiry or a quote request, only after the user gives explicit consent. Then we confirm it landed in your normal systems, such as e-commerce orders or the contact form database, ready for sales.

Reported as leads delivered, end to end.

Common questions

## Answers before you ask

What is the agentic web?

The agentic web is the machine-facing layer of a website. It presents the same business information as structured, readable data so AI assistants and agentic browsers can retrieve it, cite it and act on it without parsing a page built for human eyes.

How is this different from SEO or GEO?

SEO and GEO influence whether you are found and recommended. The agentic web decides what an agent can actually read and do once it arrives. They are complementary: visibility brings the agent, the agentic layer serves it.

Do we need to rebuild our website?

No. The agentic layer is added alongside your existing site. Your human website stays exactly as it is; we build a parallel machine-readable layer on the same domain.

How long does an agentic web build take?

A standard build runs about three weeks from audit to verified deployment. Larger sites with multiple markets or product catalogues take longer, mostly in data mapping.

Why does it need monthly upkeep?

Your website keeps changing, new crawlers and browser agents keep arriving, and the specifications themselves are still moving. Without upkeep the layer drifts out of sync and agents answer from stale data.

How do you measure whether it worked?

Four measures: the Lighthouse agentic browsing category, how well leading models describe your business when asked, agent and crawler traffic in your logs, and citation appearances in AI answers.

# B2B Lead Generation   from GO MO DBS

DBS is a sister company within GO MO Group offering outbound lead generation services. By combining proprietary tools and expertise, we are able to accurately find and target relevant decision-makers and reach them in an effective manner.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

### Outbound campaigns effectively complement inbound strategies, whether to enhance a new product launch or meet sales targets. They ensure you connect with key decision-makers in your industry.

## Expand your reach with content syndication

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Building the foundations for a successful project

Strategy

We’ll listen to your goals and get to know your business. We’ll research your competitors, identify how we can make an impact, and help solve your customer’s needs. We work with you to refine your ideas and present solutions to help you achieve your goals.

User-centric design

How your visitors engage with the content on your website is important to us. We’ll wireframe your new website to map out a straightforward user journey, from the very first impression, to how they navigate the pages and content. This helps us to design and develop a site that works hard for your brand without frustrating your users.

Project Management

With over 15 years of experience running complex design and build projects, we have established a solid process of managing studio projects that teams on both sides oversee. Our team will cut through the jargon and keep you updated at every stage of the journey.

## How we generate leads using outbound methods

There are many great tools for salespeople – many of which we use ourselves. Salespeople can now find prospects, sort these into campaigns, create automated outreach sequences, A/B test email copy, and engage thousands of prospects automatically.

Only, that isn’t automatic; optimizing that kind of sales process takes a lot of work. We propose to do all of that for you, so your sales organization can _actually_ just sit back and get warm leads to their inbox.

### Client requirements

The main factor determining your campaign success is the relevance of the recipients. For this, we start our partnerships by getting a thorough understanding of your goals and campaign objectives.

### Data mining

Our data team finds and sorts through contact data needed for the campaign and compiles this for use in the campaign(s).

### Data validation

Before deliveries, we check the validity of the data we have collected. This is both to ensure that it is in line with your campaign objectives, and to avoid things like invalid emails.

### Campaign setup

Once all the data is collected and sorted, we create the campaign in our delivery management platform and plan the rollout of your campaign.

### User engagement

Once everything is ready, your assigned campaign team will go live with the marketing channels you have chosen for your campaign.

### Delivery

The resulting leads and impressions statistics will be sent to you in the channel you prefer. Transparency is key in our services, which goes for our reporting of results too.

The Opportunity

### B2B YouTube is underinvested. That’s your advantage.

Most B2B companies spend everything on paid. YouTube’s organic channel is wide open — if you know how to build it.

**Your buyers aren’t waiting to be sold to.** They’re on YouTube right now, searching for answers to problems your product solves. How does your brand show up — or does it not show up at all?

Most B2B YouTube channels have the same problem: they’re built like broadcast channels, not discovery engines. Videos are produced for existing audiences, not for buyers who’ve never heard of you. When the paid budget stops, visibility stops.

> “YouTube is the only channel where a well-optimised video from two years ago can generate a qualified inbound lead today.”
>
> — Marcus Wahlberg, Head of YouTube Strategy, GO MO Group

We build channels that compound. Every video we brief, optimise, or structure is designed to earn organic reach through YouTube Search, Suggested content, and AI platform citations — permanently, not just while a budget runs.

Channel Audit

## We start with an honest look at what’s actually there.

Before recommending anything, we run a full diagnostic of your channel — traffic sources, discoverability, metadata quality, AI citation readiness, and competitor positioning.

**Most audits reveal the same pattern:** valuable content locked behind settings and metadata that prevent organic reach. Quick wins are almost always available before new production is needed.

##### Organic traffic: ~8% of total views

Channel relies entirely on paid promotion — no compounding reach

##### Title and description coverage: 34%

Most videos missing keyword-optimised metadata — invisible to YouTube Search

##### Chapter structure: 0 of 47 videos

No chapter timestamps = no AI citability, reduced search understanding

##### Playlist architecture: incomplete

No thematic grouping — session depth and subscriber conversion both low

##### Content quality: strong (8/10)

Existing library has real value — needs distribution strategy, not reshoot

31 Overall Channel Score

Significant organic growth potential — high-impact fixes available without new production

Built for B2B Reality

## Long sales cycles are a feature, not a problem.

In B2B, buying decisions take months. Procurement involves multiple stakeholders. Evaluation happens quietly — long before anyone contacts sales. YouTube is one of the few channels that’s actually designed for this reality.

**A well-optimised YouTube channel works the whole cycle.** The same video that builds awareness with a cold prospect in Q1 can resurface in the evaluation phase in Q3 — answering a technical question for a different stakeholder without any additional spend.

Most channels are built for the moment of purchase. We build for the entire journey.

Early stage

#### Awareness & Education

Buyers discover your brand while researching a problem — not a solution. Search-optimised explainer content puts you in the consideration set months before RFQ.

Mid stage

#### Evaluation & Comparison

Procurement teams watch demos, case studies, and technical deep-dives. Your channel becomes a self-serve resource — reducing sales team load on repeat questions.

Late stage

#### Validation & Sign-off

A single well-structured video reviewed by a CFO or legal lead the night before a decision can tip the outcome. Video is the most persuasive format at this stage — and organic reach means it's always there.

Generative Engine Optimisation

## YouTube is becoming one of AI’s primary sources.

When a buyer asks ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity a question in your category, AI platforms increasingly cite YouTube videos as authoritative sources — especially well-structured, transcript-rich content.

This is the next frontier for B2B visibility. Most companies haven’t thought about it yet. We’ve been building this into our YouTube service from day one — chapter architecture, transcript quality, answer-first scripting, and citation monitoring across AI platforms.

It’s a natural extension of our broader GEO service — applied specifically to video. If you’re investing in GEO for your website, your YouTube channel needs to work the same way.

Common Questions

## The questions that  matter most..

What’s the difference between YouTube ads and a YouTube marketing strategy?

YouTube ads generate views while your budget is active — when it stops, visibility stops. **A YouTube marketing strategy builds organic discovery** through search-optimised content, channel architecture, and playlist structure. The goal is content that compounds in value over time — reaching buyers through YouTube Search, Suggested Videos, and AI platforms without ongoing media spend per view. Both have a role, but most B2B companies are 100% dependent on paid. We change that ratio.

Do we need to create a lot of new videos to see results?

Not necessarily — and often not at all in Month 1. **The highest-impact improvements almost always come from optimising what already exists**: rewriting metadata, adding chapter structure, adjusting visibility settings, reorganising channel architecture, and building playlists. Most companies have a video library that significantly underperforms its potential. We unlock that first, then build a content strategy around proven demand.

Is YouTube actually relevant for B2B companies in industrial or technical sectors?

Especially so. **Technical buyers actively use YouTube** to understand how products work, compare specifications, and validate decisions before involving procurement. Categories like industrial equipment, construction machinery, logistics software, enterprise technology, and professional services all have genuine search demand on YouTube. The opportunity is large precisely because most B2B companies in these sectors have not yet invested in organic YouTube strategy — which means first movers will compound their advantage.

We also get asked about: attribution and pipeline tracking, multi-market and multilingual strategies, how YouTube connects to broader GEO and AI search, how long organic growth takes, and how we integrate with in-house content teams. We cover all of this in your initial audit conversation.

# Content: the Core  of Pull Marketing Strategies

High-quality content is fundamental to a successful digital marketing strategy. Our expert content writers produce texts for your web pages, making sure to portray your business correctly while also working closely with SEO experts to make sure your website is visible on search engines.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

### Expert content team

Our content writers have extensive experience in writing SEO content for B2B companies. The combined effort of a specialist content writer and an SEO team is greater than any one generalist resource, giving you content preferred both by humans and search engine crawlers.

## A content strategy must be built using an outside-in perspective – if you write content based on what your readers find relevant and interesting, it will also perform well.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Complex B2B Content is Our Expertise

B2B Digital Marketing

GO MO is uniquely positioned in its focus on B2B digital marketing. As such, we have the processes and expertise to create high-quality texts about even the most complex B2B products.

Target Audience

In B2B marketing, the target audience is usually very knowledgeable, and we have to show these potential buyers that our client also knows their specific industry – its trends, challenges, and opportunities.

Mastering Deep-Dive Content for Complex Industries

For complex industries, we understand that surface-level, introductory content simply won’t suffice. To truly engage a well-informed potential buyer, we need to delve deep, providing comprehensive insights and detailed analysis. This approach ensures we address the sophisticated challenges and questions such buyers frequently have, establishing our expertise and building trust.

## Complex B2B Content: Our expertise

GO MO is uniquely positioned in its focus on B2B digital marketing. As such, we have the processes and expertise to create high-quality texts about even the most complex B2B products.

In B2B marketing, the target audience is usually very knowledgeable, and we have to show these potential buyers that our client also knows their specific industry – its trends, challenges, and opportunities. Especially for complex industries, we know we cannot get by with surface-level, introductory content. We need to go deep and write for a well-informed potential buyer.

### Strategy from data – text for humans

Search engine algorithms are constantly getting better at identifying original and high-quality content. As such, we place the human reader first – focusing on what they are likely to find interesting and appealing. There is a strong [connection between good UX and SEO performance](https://www.gomogroup.com/insikter/utilizing-googles-data-to-win/), so an outside-in audience focus is an important part of an SEO strategy.

While the content strategy comes from data, the content is ultimately written for your potential clients. We take great care to portray your brand as a trustworthy source of information and to accurately reflect your products and services, in all their nuances.

### Audience-centric content creation

Effective content creation hinges on addressing the target audience’s needs and interests, rather than focusing solely on the sender’s message. This outside-in perspective enables the crafting of content that is both engaging and functional, avoiding the trap of producing content merely for the sake of it.

By aligning content with what the audience finds relevant and valuable, engagement and content performance are significantly enhanced. This approach requires research to grasp the audience’s behaviors and interests, ensuring that every piece of content has a clear purpose and meets their expectations.

## Key Features of Our   Demand Generation with   Online Acceleration

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Targeted Account (ABM)

Our ABM (Account Based Marketing) focused Online Acceleration offering focuses on attracting customers who are a best fit for your product or service. This is achieved through various tactics like content syndication and email automation, but tailored to resonate with the specific needs and challenges of your ideal customer.

Content Syndication

High-quality content is king in demand generation. We educate potential customers about your industry, showcase your expertise, and position you as a thought leader. This content can take many forms like blog posts, infographics, ebooks, whitepapers, podcasts or webinars.

Lead Generation

Demand generation isn’t just about awareness, it’s about converting that interest into qualified leads that convert. We help capture contact information through calls to action (CTAs) on our website, landing pages, or downloadable content.

Intent Nurturing

Not all leads are sales-ready right away. Demand generation with online acceleration includes nurturing baked on intent with targeted email campaigns, personalized content, and educational resources that move them further down the sales funnel.

Measurable Results

Effective demand generation is data-driven. We make sure to track key metrics like traffic, lead engagements & conversion rates along with customer acquisition costs to measure the success of your campaigns and optimize strategies for better results.

Adding our Online Acceleration Strategy to outreach allows you to engage both active and passive prospects. This approach ensures you reach decision-makers who are ready to buy and those who need additional nurturing, creating a comprehensive and effective marketing strategy.

## Building the Foundations for Your Success

### Target Audience Understanding

Understanding your target audience is the cornerstone of any successful demand generation strategy. This involves:

**Developing Buyer Personas**

Create detailed profiles of your ideal customers, including demographics, behaviors, pain points, and buying motivations.

**Audience Segmentation**

Divide your audience into distinct segments based on specific criteria such as industry, job role, company size, or buying behavior. This allows for more personalized and effective marketing efforts.

**Customer Journey Mapping**

Understand the different stages of the buyer’s journey and tailor your content and outreach strategies to meet the needs of your audience at each stage.

### Integrated Marketing Approach

An integrated marketing approach ensures a consistent and cohesive message across all channels, increasing the effectiveness of your demand generation efforts. This involves:

**Multichannel Campaigns**

Utilize a mix of marketing channels, including email, social media, content marketing, SEO, PPC, podcasts, webinars, and events. This maximizes reach and engagement with your target audience.

**Consistent Messaging**

Ensure that your messaging is consistent across all channels and touchpoints to build brand recognition and trust.

**Synergistic Tactics**

Combine inbound (pull) and outbound (push) marketing tactics to engage both active and passive prospects, ensuring a comprehensive strategy that covers all potential customer touchpoints.

### Data and Analytics

Leveraging data and analytics is essential for tracking performance, making informed decisions, and continuously optimizing your demand generation strategy. This includes:

**Performance Metrics**

Monitor key metrics such as traffic, lead quality, conversion rates, and ROI. This helps in assessing the effectiveness of your campaigns and identifying areas for improvement.

**Marketing Automation and CRM**

Use marketing automation tools and CRM systems to manage and track interactions with prospects. This enables more efficient lead nurturing, reporting and provides campaign insights into customer behavior.

**A/B Testing and Optimization**

Regularly test different elements of your campaigns (e.g., subject lines, content formats, CTAs) to identify what works best. Use these insights to refine and optimize your strategy for better results.

## Online Audience Acceleration vs.   Traditional Demand Generation

Demand generation with Online Audience Acceleration, efficiently targets and converts the right audience at the right time. By integrating tactics such as content marketing, automated emails, and data-driven decisions, it effectively engages prospects that convert. Additionally, it leverages intent data to prioritize in-market audiences, enhancing its targeting precision and conversion rates.

# Harness the Future of Search with  Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

AI search engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — are replacing traditional search clicks. If your brand isn’t cited, you’re invisible. GO MO Group gives you the strategy, data, and execution to change that.

[Book a GEO Audit](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/#service-page-form-section) [Free GEO Playbook](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/geo-playbook/)

213M+

LLM prompts tracked globally

5

AI engines monitored

10+

Years of search expertise

#1

Nordic AIO Partner — SEMrush

Partnership announcement

## GO MO is  the Nordics’ first SEMrush Enterprise AIO Partner

We’ve partnered with SEMrush — the world’s largest SEO & AI Visibility platform — giving our clients access to enterprise-grade data that most Nordic companies simply can’t get on their own. Real brand mention monitoring, conversion-linked visibility data, and a 213M+ prompt database tracking how AI engines answer questions in your industry.

ChatGPT  Perplexity  Gemini  Microsoft Copilot  Meta AI

Why GEO matters now

## AI search is becoming the default path to purchase

The way people find and evaluate B2B vendors is changing faster than most companies realise. GO MO Group’s approach: not having a strategy is not a strategy.

##### The shift is already here

63% of B2B buyers use AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity during research. AI search is not a future trend — it’s the current reality for your buyers, right now.

##### Visibility in AI = citations

In AI search, rankings don’t exist. You’re either cited and recommended, or you’re not. Authority, relevance, and source trustworthiness determine who wins.

##### Zero-click is accelerating

AI answers are reducing click-through to websites significantly. If your brand isn’t cited within the answer itself, you receive zero credit — no traffic, no lead.

##### First movers win the category

AI engines develop preferences for certain sources over time. Companies investing in GEO now are building moats that will be increasingly difficult for competitors to close.

How we work

## A data-driven yet experimental strategy

What sets GO MO apart is enterprise data access through our SEMrush partnership. Every approach we take is measured, not hypothesised.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Experiments

GEO is still an emerging discipline — there’s genuine uncertainty about what works at scale. We run structured experiments across content formats, entity coverage, citation-building, and schema markup to identify what actually moves visibility metrics. We share learnings openly with our clients, and we commit to a set of promising activities while acknowledging what’s still being tested.

Competitor and industry benchmarking

**Powered by SEMrush AIO data**

Using SEMrush’s Enterprise AIO platform, we track how your competitors are being cited across 213M+ LLM prompts globally. We identify which brands are winning citations in your category, which topics they own, and where the gaps are that you can exploit. This is competitive intelligence most agencies simply don’t have access to.

Education and internal communication

GEO requires cross-functional alignment — marketing, content, PR, and leadership all play a role. We help your team understand what GEO is, why it matters, and how to build it into your content process. We provide internal comms assets, executive summaries, and training sessions so your organization moves as one.

## Common questions about GEO

What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) focuses on ranking in traditional search engines like Google — getting your page to appear at the top of a results page. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) focuses on getting your brand cited and recommended within AI-generated answers from tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

The key difference: in SEO you earn a position in a list. In GEO you earn a mention within a conversational answer. The signals that drive each are related but distinct — GEO places greater weight on entity authority, citation across trusted sources, and content that answers questions comprehensively.

What is Generative Engine Optimization?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring your brand’s digital presence so that AI language models and search engines — like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google’s AI Overviews — are more likely to reference, cite, and recommend your brand when users ask relevant questions.

It involves optimizing content for how LLMs crawl and process information, building entity authority across the web, and ensuring your brand is clearly associated with the topics and problems your customers are asking AI about.

Is GEO replacing SEO?

Not replacing — but fundamentally reshaping. Traditional SEO remains important, especially for transactional queries and local search. But the share of research and discovery happening through AI search is growing rapidly, particularly in B2B contexts where buyers use tools like ChatGPT to evaluate vendors before ever visiting a website.

The smartest approach is to treat GEO and SEO as complementary disciplines. Many of the foundations — strong content, authoritative backlinks, technical health — benefit both. GEO adds a new layer: entity building, AI citation optimization, and prompt-level visibility tracking.

# Programmatic   Advertising

Make use of big data and AI technology to promote your brand more effectively online. Using programmatic advertising to automate the process of buying ad space lets you maximize your brand exposure towards a very specific target audience in real-time and grow your business.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

### What is programmatic advertising?

Programmatic advertising is characterized by automating the processes related to showing ads in digital channels. Whereas online advertising started out with companies buying ad space on a per-website basis, it is now possible to accurately target one’s target audience in the most effective channels through programmatic advertising. In short, it lets you advertise through a **joint force of data science, automation, and machine learning**.

## Advancements in machine learning have let automation in programmatic advertising become incredibly accurate, presenting customers with a lot more relevant offers than ever before.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Programmatic advertising: reach your target audience effectively

Optimal management

We have managed the programmatic advertising for large organizations and small local companies with great results. Adding programmatic advertising to a data-driven digital marketing strategy can significantly increase the ROI and directly contribute to the B2B lead generation.

Cornerstone of Pull Marketing

Programmatic advertising is vital for effective Pull Marketing, allowing ads to reach only those who show or are likely to show interest in your offerings. By continuously refining ad targeting to align with client purchasing patterns, businesses can enhance engagement and drive conversions.

Programmatic advertising in B2B

While more often talked about in a B2C context, programmatic advertising is likewise an effective approach to B2B marketing. It can for instance be used as a push marketing tool to target C-suite individuals and increase awareness among decision-makers. Programmatic can also be a highly effective tool for tasks like recruitment and talent acquisition. By effectively targeting a narrow audience, it is possible to reach B2B decision-makers in highly relevant companies.

## Programmatic advertising in B2B

Correct execution of programmatic advertising allows companies to only show their ads to an audience for which their products and services are relevant. This is a cornerstone of Pull Marketing, wherein marketing communications is targeted towards individuals who have expressed interest in your products/services. Programmatic allows you to target these individuals, but also those who are likely to be similarly interested in your offering. For optimal results, the ad management needs to be continuously updated to ensure that your targeting is consistent with your clients’ purchasing patterns.

Narrowing down the target market of your marketing communications will greatly improve the campaigns’ conversion rate, as well as being more financially efficient. Manual targeting might allow advertisers to show their ads for a select number of websites at specific times. On the other hand, programmatic advertising allows for a more true people-based marketing, as more factors can be accounted for. Combine this with real-time bidding and it is hard to argue for a non-programmatic approach in one’s online advertising.

### How does programmatic advertising work?

A key aspect of programmatic advertising is real-time bidding. Pairing advertiser preferences with available ad space allows companies to show their ads to the most relevant internet users efficiently. With numerous websites to advertise on and many companies looking to do so, having a strategy that optimizes ad placement is crucial. This enables more personalized strategies on a large scale.

Advertisers use demand-side platforms (DSP) to manage their campaigns, specifying parameters that determine who sees the ad and when. Conversely, website owners use supply-side platforms (SSP) to control what’s shown on their sites. In the brief time it takes a browser to load a webpage, the SSP announces an available ad space. DSPs then match advertisers’ preferences to present relevant ads. The highest bidding advertiser for the ad space and user in question gets their ad displayed.

### B2B Programmatic advertising

Consumers are increasingly in control over the course of their buyer’s journeys. Instead of being exposed to ads and communications from whichever companies scream the loudest, buyers are now doing their own research to find the best solutions to their problems. This paradigm shift is clear in both B2C and B2B purchasing, and is something to which companies must adapt.

Pull Marketing means communicating towards individuals with pre-existing demand. Implementing Pull Marketing involves positioning oneself to be visible in the recipients’ channel of choice at the time they are looking for products and services, rather than pushing one’s offerings in the hopes of creating demand.

### Optimal management of   programmatic advertising

Our experience in managing programmatic advertising spans across both large organizations and small local companies, consistently delivering outstanding results. Integrating programmatic advertising into a data-driven digital marketing strategy not only boosts the ROI but also plays a crucial role in [B2B lead generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-lead-generation/). By leveraging targeted ads and real-time bidding, programmatic techniques ensure that your marketing efforts are both efficient and effective, directly contributing to increased lead acquisition and business growth.

### The role of data and privacy

Another advantage of automation between DSPs and SSPs is enhanced privacy. As consumer and company concerns about user privacy grow, and with the phase-out of third-party cookies, ad vendors must find alternative ways to determine ad relevance. Data-learning in DSPs and SSPs allows advertisers to more accurately predict user interest with less personal information. This shift poses challenges for smaller advertisers and ad vendors, who may need to partner with larger entities possessing more first-hand data.

# Pull Marketing:  Engaging and Attracting Customers with Ease

Pull Marketing is marketing to individuals and organizations with an expressed demand for one’s services or products. By targeting an interested audience lets companies capitalize on existing demand, and ensures that they are part of each potential client’s buying journey.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

### Close the Gap Between Marketing and Sales

Consumers are increasingly in control over the course of their buyer’s journeys. Instead of being exposed to ads and communications from whichever companies scream the loudest, buyers are now doing their own research to find the best solutions to their problems. This paradigm shift is clear in both B2C and B2B purchasing, and is something to which companies must adapt.

Pull Marketing means communicating towards individuals with pre-existing demand. Implementing Pull Marketing involves positioning oneself to be visible in the recipients’ channel of choice at the time they are looking for products and services, rather than pushing one’s offerings in the hopes of creating demand.

## We are living through history’s biggest paradigm shift in communication.  Closing the gap between marketing and sales requires an outside-in perspective.

![](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Untitled-design-1-.gif.webp)

### Customer-Centric and Data-Driven Marketing

Understand Clients Buying Process

By starting with your customers’ needs and search behaviors, your company can quickly advance in the buying process by being visible to decision-makers searching for services. Search engines are part of 94% of all B2B buying processes, and many cite a search engine as the most important channel in their purchasing journey. As an SEO agency, we can help your business appear on Google and be a viable option in your customers’ buying process.

SEO Based on Data

All of our partnerships begin with a thorough marketing analysis that clarifies both internal and external SEO factors. For successful search engine optimization, it is essential that the website is technically correct to be found by search engines, and that it is filled with content optimized for potential customers’ search behaviors. When the strategy is developed using data, it is possible to invest more significantly and move more swiftly.

B2B SEO-Strategies

SEO is more than just a component of the larger digital marketing strategy; it benefits from having both content and geographic diversity. GO MO Group is a B2B SEO agency with experience extending across multiple markets. We use data to identify which markets and tactics are relevant.

## Be Visible  When the Customer  Searches for You.

Pull Marketing works for all industries, but is especially effective in supporting high-complexity sales processes.

Pull Marketing is a powerful way to support high-complexity purchasing processes. Complexity is characterized by more decision-makers, long time-to-close, and larger deals.

### The Paradigm Shift is Clear

Consumers are increasingly in control over the course of their buyer’s journeys. Instead of being exposed to ads and communications from whichever companies scream the loudest, buyers are now doing their own research to find the best solutions to their problems. This paradigm shift is clear in both B2C and B2B purchasing, and is something to which companies must adapt.

Pull Marketing means communicating towards individuals with pre-existing demand. Implementing Pull Marketing involves positioning oneself to be visible in the recipients’ channel of choice at the time they are looking for products and services, rather than pushing one’s offerings in the hopes of creating demand.

### Be Available

An Accenture report shows that 94% of all B2B buying processes begin online. A report from Postnord shows that 87% of the research process takes place via Google/ Search Engines. The statistics also show that B2B consumers do NOT do their research via advertisements.

With this information, it is easy to understand where to focus to increase sales. You must be available when the customer searches for you on the right channels, with the right information in hand. The important thing is to understand what the customer wants online – this is called Pull Marketing.

### Quantitative Communication

Pull-marketing is about getting in touch with everyone who is looking for your specific services and products. Companies must change their marketing plans, reduce quantitative campaigns and prioritize a qualitative Pull-marketing strategy that creates measurable growth. [Take advantage of the digital transformation](https://www.mckinsey.com/business-functions/organization/our-insights/unlocking-success-in-digital-transformations) in marketing and become more specific in your marketing activities to create results and increase sales.

The trend is clear: companies need to change their focus and understand the possibilities of marketing and communication that is driven by existing market needs. The future of marketing is _Pull_.

### Combination of   People & Technologies

Successful Pull-marketing requires a combination of people and technology. Whereas search engines are unclear as to what efforts are the most impactful, but there are many tools that produce useful data. A lone consultant can do a lot with a carefully chosen service, but by combining several analytical tools, our teams can get high-quality and results that are more reliable than a single source.

Project Management

With over 15 years of experience running complex design and build projects, we have established a solid process of managing studio projects that teams on both sides oversee. Our team will cut through the jargon and keep you updated at every stage of the journey.

## Agile Search Engine Advertising

Search engines have quickly become the most important platforms for pull marketing strategies, as they allow companies to communicate to a relevant audience. To add search engine advertising to your marketing mix can be an effective way to guarantee your visibility on search engines. Since you can buy visibility on specific search phrases, it is possible to employ very precise targeting strategies to reach individuals who are looking to buy.

### Market Towards   Intentions, not Audience

When you are visible on the SERP as your customers search for solutions to their business problems, you are positioned as an alternative – you’re part of their buyer’s journey. Depending on the goals of your SEA strategy, GO MO Group optimizes your campaigns to be directly aligned with those goals. Search engine advertising works both for branding and sales. The secret is to plan according to search intentions, not audiences.

### Analytics

There is a lot of data available for optimizing SEA campaigns. By analyzing your website and what keywords your competitors are buying ads on, we can get accurate prognostics on how different campaigns would perform. When basing your strategic decisions on data, you can bet more boldly and implement new tactics faster. For this reason, we always begin with a thorough audit.

### Agile & Iterative Processes

A strategy for B2B search engine advertising cannot be static. Just like with SEO, SEA gets the best results when carefully planned in combination with the rest of the digital marketing strategy. Depending on your budget, we formulate the SEA strategy to position you in the most effective way. Our iterative process allows us to test different approaches and find the optimal SEA strategy for you. Being best is about never settling. By continuous reporting and re-optimizing the aspects of your SEA campaigns and strategy, we are able to bring you further than ever.

# Boost Your  Online Visibility    with Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Almost all purchasing processes begin on Google – even in B2B. This makes search engines the most effective platform for communicating to potential customers, and SEO is a central part of digital marketing.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/contact-us/)

### The Impact of Generative AI on SEO

We live in a rapidly evolving digital world, with artificial intelligence (AI) playing an increasingly significant role in SEO – from how we design strategies and interpret search patterns to how we apply our knowledge for effective leadership. As businesses, it’s high time to adapt to this new reality swiftly. In the video below, Gabriel Ghavami, CEO of GO MO Group, and Kristina Bergwall, Director of SEO and Analytics at Web Guide Partner, share their expert perspectives on the impact of AI on SEO and why it’s so crucial to keep up with the development. For more, see the full-length conversation here.

## SEO is broken. By helping people to buy rather than sell, we see organic and stable growth. Closing the gap between marketing and sales requires an outside-in perspective.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20720%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Customer-Centric SEO Drives Business

Understand Clients Buying Process

By starting with your customers’ needs and search behaviors, your company can quickly advance in the buying process by being visible to decision-makers searching for services. Search engines are part of 94% of all B2B buying processes, and many cite a search engine as the most important channel in their purchasing journey. As an SEO agency, we can help your business appear on Google and be a viable option in your customers’ buying process..

SEO Based on Data

All of our partnerships begin with a thorough marketing analysis that clarifies both internal and external SEO factors. For successful search engine optimization, it is essential that the website is technically correct to be found by search engines, and that it is filled with content optimized for potential customers’ search behaviors. When the strategy is developed using data, it is possible to invest more significantly and move more swiftly.

B2B SEO-Strategies

SEO is more than just a component of the larger digital marketing strategy; it benefits from having both content and geographic diversity. GO MO Group is a B2B SEO agency with experience extending across multiple markets. We use data to identify which markets and tactics are relevant.

## Data-Driven SEO Strategy  and Optimal Execution

There’s a new B2B buyer out there: She is younger, digitally engaged, and conducts her research online – companies’ sales methods must fundamentally change to meet these new purchasing behaviors.

The buyer is in the driver’s seat, and marketing needs to adapt to meet and facilitate new buying processes. We are convinced that B2B SEO and pull marketing is a must for companies.

Successful B2B search engine optimization will make your website more visible to relevant buyers and decision-makers. Instead of treating cold leads, your sales organization can instead convert warm leads that have already interacted with your brand and are ready to build a relationship. At the same time, pages that rank high on Google are perceived to be trustworthy, which contributes to a strong brand.

### SEO that Markets You Directly to Decision-Makers

Adapting your communication strategy to your customers’ needs and search behaviors your company will let you communicate with decision-makers as they are looking for solutions to their problems. Search engines are part of 94 % of all B2B buying processes, and many consider the search engine to be the most important channel in their buying journey. We help you be visible on Google, making your company part of almost all your potential customers’ purchasing decisions.

### SEO Strategy   Based on Data

All our partnerships begin with a thorough digital marketing audit where we analyze internal and external SEO factors. Successful search engine optimization requires both correct technical implementation of SEO factors, and on-page content optimized according to potential buyers’ search behaviors. Using data to develop a strategy allows for bolder bets and faster implementation.

### B2B SEO   Strategy

We understand that SEO is part of a larger digital marketing strategy. GO MO Group is a B2B [SEO agency](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/) experienced in implementing SEO strategies spanning several markets. The web is worldwide, and digital marketing is likewise not limited to any specific region. Because of this, we are well-versed in cross-market SEO strategies and international digital marketing.

### Combination of   People & Technologies

Successful SEO requires a combination of people and technology. Whereas search engines are unclear as to what efforts are the most impactful, but there are many tools that produce useful data. A lone SEO consultant can do a lot with a carefully chosen service, but by combining several analytical tools, our teams can get high-quality and results that are more reliable than a single source.

## FAQ

Are these designs fully AI-generated?

Not entirely. We use Generative AI to speed up and scale the creative process, but visual is reviewed, refined, and finalized by our experts to ensure quality and brand alignment.

How does AI improve the design process?

AI helps us explore more concepts faster, automate repetitive tasks, and speed up production. This means quicker turnarounds, more creative options, and efficient scaling—while human designers focus on strategy, UX, and storytelling.

Will the designs match our brand guidelines?

Yes. Brand alignment is central to our process. We train prompts, workflows, and design decisions around your brand guidelines, and our designers ensure every output feels cohesive, intentional, and on-brand.

Can I request revisions or changes?

Yes, absolutely. We include revision rounds as part of our process to ensure the final output meets your expectations. Because our workflow is AI-assisted, iterations are faster and more efficient—while our designers ensure every change maintains quality, clarity, and brand consistency.

title: Agentic Web Services for B2B
description: Make your website readable, citable and actionable for AI assistants. GO MO Group builds agentic web layers with structured data, APIs, llms.txt and MCP.
markdown:
# Bygg lagret som  AI faktiskt läser, förstår och kan agera utifrån

Den agentiska webben är det maskininriktade lagret av din webbplats – ditt företag utifrån strukturerad data som AI-assistenter och agentiska webbläsare kan läsa, citera och agera utifrån.

[KONTAKTA OSS](https://www.gomogroup.com/kontakta-oss/)

6

Komponenter i lagret

8+/10

Genomsnittligt betyg på LLM-svar

3/3

Godkända agentkontroller i Lighthouse

2/2

Leads från AI-agenter levererade via MCP

Varför den agentiska webben är viktig nu

## Agenter blir den första läsaren av din webbplats

Hur människor hittar och utvärderar B2B-leverantörer förändras snabbare än de flesta företag inser. En assistent läser en handfull källor och skriver ett enda svar — och det finns ingen sida två att synas på.

##### Googles andel av sökningar sjönk till 75,5 %

På fem år flyttade ungefär en femtedel av alla sökfrågor till assistenter som svarar istället för att länka. Efterfrågan finns kvar — det är gränssnittet som har bytts ut.

Statcounter, 2020 jämfört med 2026

##### 53 % av webbtrafiken är inte längre mänsklig

På de flesta webbplatser är majoriteten av besökarna nu mjukvara, och de har läst sidor formgivna för ögon — och gått miste om allt det som layouten döljer.

Imperva Bad Bot Report, 2026

##### Lighthouse har redan en femte kategori för det

Lighthouse har lagt till agentisk webbläsning som en femte kategori, som granskas vid varje körning av PageSpeed Insights — inklusive en kontroll som inte körs alls utan en llms.txt.

Chrome Lighthouse

##### Nästan inga konkurrenter har detta lager

Nästan inga konkurrenter inom industriell B2B har ett maskinläsbart lager idag. De företag som bygger ett nu blir den källa som modellerna lär sig att lita på och citera.

GO MO Group, marknadsöversikt

Där agenterna redan finns

## Webbläsaren är nu  själv en agent

Skiftet handlar inte bara om crawlers. Alla stora webbläsare har nu ett läge där mjukvaran läser sidan, avgör vad som är viktigt och rapporterar tillbaka — användaren kanske aldrig ser din layout alls.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Google

##### Gemini i Chrome

Läser sidan du befinner dig på, svarar på frågor om den och navigerar mellan flikar på användarens vägnar.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

OpenAI

##### ChatGPT Atlas

En webbläsare byggd kring assistenten, med ett agentläge som utför flerstegsuppgifter på webbplatser.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Perplexity

##### Comet

Assistent-först-webbläsning: den jämför källor mellan öppna flikar och lämnar tillbaka ett urval av källor, inte en sida.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2026%2026'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Microsoft

##### Edge Copilot Mode

Copilot läser det som är öppet, sammanfattar det och kan agera utifrån det — i den webbläsare som de flesta företag redan använder.

I alla fyra fall är layouten valfri. Det agenten lyckas hämta är ditt varumärke — och Chrome granskar nu hur väl den klarar det.

Ett varumärke, två webbplatser

## Du bygger inte om.  Du lägger till ett lager.

En webbplats är byggd för människor: JavaScript, media och formgivning på flera nivåer. Agenter vill ha samma information, men som ren, strukturerad data. Därför lägger vi till den — på din domän, sida vid sida med det du redan har.

##### Webbplats för människor

Redan på plats ✓

- → Designad för ögon, varumärke och konvertering
- → Renderas i webbläsaren, ofta JavaScript-tung
- → Informationen ligger inbäddad layouten

+

##### Webbplats för agenter

Nytt lager · det vi bygger

- → Designad för hämtning, citering och handling
- → Levereras som ren, strukturerad data
- → Kan anropas som ett verktyg, inte bara läsas

Vad vi levererar

## Vad ett  agentiskt webblager innehåller

Sex komponenter. Ett sammanhängande lager. Allt en AI-agent behöver för att hitta ditt företag, läsa din information rätt och anropa det direkt.

/agent

##### Agentsida

En maskinläsbar sida med strukturerad data formaterad för att agenter ska kunna upptäcka och citera den.

/llms.txt

##### llms.txt

Indexet agenter letar efter först — vad din webbplats innehåller och var de kanoniska svaren finns.

schema.org

##### Strukturerad data

Märkning för organisation, tjänst, produkt och FAQ över hela webbplatsen, så att fakta blir entydiga.

/.well-known

##### API-katalog

En offentlig katalog så att system för agent-orkestrering kan upptäcka och interagera programmatiskt med din webbplats.

/api/v1

##### Offentligt REST-API

Ett lättviktigt, skrivskyddat API som delar dina viktigaste uppgifter och data — alltid korrekt, alltid strukturerad.

/mcp

##### MCP server

Så att Claude, ChatGPT och alla MCP-kompatibla agenter kan läsa och hämta din data direkt som ett verktyg.

Så levererar vi

## Fyra steg,   cirka tre veckor

Ditt team ger oss tillgång och svar. Vi gör resten och lämnar tillbaka ett verifierat lager.

Steg 1

Granska

+

Vi kör er webbplats genom vår audit för agentisk browsing, kontrollerar vad AI-agenter faktiskt kan hämta och identifierar vilka affärsfakta som är oläsbara, saknas eller återges felaktigt i AI-svar.

Steg 2

Bygg

+

Vi bygger de sex komponenterna utifrån ert faktiska innehåll och era datakällor – agentsida, llms.txt, strukturerad data, API-katalog, REST API och MCP-server.

Steg 3

Driftsätt

+

Allt publiceras på er egen domän, med behörigheter för crawlers och AI-agenter medvetet konfigurerade i robots.txt och ai.txt. Ingenting hostas någon annanstans.

Steg 4

Verifiera & synka

+

Därefter kör vi auditten igen och utvärderar hur ledande AI-modeller beskriver er. Sedan fortsätter arbetet månadsvis: er webbplats förändras, nya agenter tillkommer och specifikationerna utvecklas – därför uppdateras lagret löpande för att följa utvecklingen.

Sätt att komma igång

## Tre ingångar

Granskning

##### Granskning av agentberedskap

Var du står idag, vad agenter kan och inte kan läsa, och vad ledande modeller säger om dig.

- → Lighthouse agentic-resultat
- → Granskning av modellsvar
- → Prioriterad lista över brister

Populärast

Bygg

##### Komplett agentiskt webbproduktion

Alla sex komponenter, driftsatta på din domän och verifierade mot granskningen av agentisk webbläsning.

- → Granskning ingår
- → Sex komponenter i drift
- → Cirka tre veckor

Underhåll

##### Bygg + månatlig synkning

Bygget, plus att lagret hålls aktuellt när ditt innehåll, agenterna och specifikationerna förändras.

- → Innehållssynk
- → Hantering av nya agenter
- → Månadsrapport med resultat

Vad du får ut av det

## Varför B2B-företag  bygger detta nu

✓

##### Citerad, inte bara genomsökt

Dina fakta dyker upp i AI-svar som dina egna, med källa från din domän.

Vanliga frågor

## Vanliga frågor om den agentiska webben

Hur får jag mitt företag citerat av ChatGPT, Gemini och Perplexity?

För att bli citerad av ChatGPT, Gemini och Perplexity behöver ditt företag information som AI-assistenter kan läsa och lita på. Det gör du genom att lägga till ett agentiskt webblager på din webbplats, ett maskinläsbart lager där dina fakta finns som strukturerad data. Lagret innehåller bland annat:

- en llms.txt som visar AI-assistenterna var de viktigaste svaren om ditt företag finns
- strukturerad data (schema.org) om ditt företag, dina tjänster och dina produkter
- en agentsida som samlar det viktigaste på ett ställe

Ingen kan garantera att en AI-modell citerar dig. Men med ett agentiskt webblager hämtar AI-assistenterna dina uppgifter direkt från din webbplats, och vi följer upp vad modellerna faktiskt säger om dig.

Vad är den agentiska webben, och varför spelar den roll för B2B-företag?

Den agentiska webben är ett maskininriktat lager på din webbplats, byggt för AI-assistenter och agentiska webbläsare. Där finns samma information om ditt företag som på resten av webbplatsen, fast som strukturerad data som AI kan läsa, citera och agera utifrån.

Den agentiska webben spelar roll för B2B-företag eftersom allt mer av researchen kring leverantörer sker via AI-assistenter. En AI-assistent läser bara en handfull källor och skriver ett enda svar. Med ett maskinläsbart lager på din webbplats ökar chansen att ditt företag blir en av de källorna.

Hur skiljer sig agentisk webb från SEO och GEO?

SEO och GEO avgör om ditt företag hittas och rekommenderas. Agentisk webb avgör vad en AI-agent faktiskt kan läsa och göra när den väl har kommit till din webbplats. Det ena ersätter inte det andra. Synligheten tar agenten till dig, och det agentiska lagret ger den det den behöver.

Behöver jag bygga om min webbplats för agentisk webb?

Nej. Det agentiska lagret läggs till bredvid din befintliga webbplats. För dina besökare ser allt ut och fungerar precis som i dag. Vi bygger det maskinläsbara lagret parallellt, på samma domän.

Hur lång tid tar det att bygga ett agentiskt lager?

Ett standardbygge av det agentiska lagret tar ungefär tre veckor, från audit till verifierad driftsättning. Större webbplatser med flera marknader eller produktkataloger tar längre tid. Oftast är det datamappningen som kräver mer arbete.

Varför behöver det agentiska lagret synkas varje månad?

Det agentiska lagret behöver synkas löpande eftersom din webbplats förändras hela tiden. Nya crawlers och webbläsaragenter dyker upp, och specifikationerna utvecklas fortfarande. Utan underhåll glider lagret ur synk, och agenterna svarar utifrån inaktuell information.

Hur mäter man om agentisk webb fungerar?

Vi mäter effekten av det agentiska lagret med fyra mått:

- kategorin för agentisk browsing i Lighthouse
- hur väl ledande AI-modeller beskriver ditt företag när de får frågor om det
- trafik från agenter och crawlers i dina serverloggar
- hur ofta ditt företag citeras i AI-genererade svar
