# Meet Safa

I’m Safa, managing director of GO MO Group in India. I’ve been stationed at our Pune office since 2013, and love to be able to work closely with our teams of specialists. I have always been an entrepreneur, and have previously worked in São Paulo, Brazil, and Gurgaon, India.

### Education

MSc in International Business and Management from the University of Manchester and a BSc in Business Administration with an emphasis in Management from California State University: Long Beach.

### About my role

I have a passion for international business and marketing. When I got the chance to combine these two at GO MO Group, I immediately jumped at the opportunity. I believe that a team with the right coordination and leadership can achieve things way above any individual’s capacity. My position between the Swedish and Indian offices makes me a key player in enabling our respective teams to perform at their best.

### Up close and personal

In my free time, I enjoy reading books on personal growth, and I am a true foodie – the only thing that can make good company better is good food. Especially if this combination happens to coincide with a win for Chelsea FC.

# Möt Anuvinder

Jag är Director och Partner på GO MO Group DBS samt ansvarig för avdelningen Online Acceleration på GO MO. Jag är expert inom demand generation, e-postautomation och content syndication. Jag brinner för att bygga processer och plattformar som automatiserar arbetsflöden och minimerar manuellt arbete.

Min filosofi: _Improvisera, automatisera, delegera!_

### Utbildning

- Kandidatexamen i företagsekonomi från MIT Pune
- Masterexamen i statsvetenskap från Pune University
- Masterexamen i marknadsföring och handel från Monash University

### Om min roll

Mitt mål är att överbrygga gapet mellan marknad och försäljning genom att utveckla datadrivna och intent-baserade erbjudanden som hjälper våra kunder att maximera avkastningen på sina marknadsinsatser med hjälp av teknik och AI.

Jag vaknar varje dag med ambitionen att ge datadriven vägledning och professionellt stöd till våra kunder. Mitt mål är att erbjuda ett heltäckande utbud av lösningar som bidrar till att utveckla och stärka våra kunders verksamheter.

Mitt motto: Bygg förtroende genom tre kärnprinciper – kvalitet, transparens och engagemang.

### Personligt

Jag är även affärsängel med en stark passion för startups och teknik. Utöver mina investeringar engagerar jag mig i att stötta lokala entreprenörer i deras tillväxtresa.

Med över 12 års erfarenhet och gedigen kunskap rådgör jag företag kring processer och strategier som driver tillväxt – och är en värdefull tillgång för organisationer som vill ta sin verksamhet till nästa nivå.

# Meet Gabriel Ghavami

I’m Gabriel —founder, CEO, father, and someone who believes that building something meaningful is always personal. Born in Tehran, grew up in Gothenburg, and later spent a few important years in New York and Hawaii—where I studied marketing and finance. Years that, early on, gave me a global perspective that keeps me curious, grounded, and focused, even when things move fast. Made me a person driven by purpose over noise.

Based in Gothenburg, but I spend a lot of time in Stockholm and Copenhagen. As a board member of Collaboration Art, I also get to work alongside our sister companies—and that gives me a broader view into the digital commerce journeys happening across industries.

### Building, not following

GO MO, for me, was never about entering the race. _**It was about changing how the game is played.**_ From the start, I wanted to build a company that didn’t just fit in—but one that set the bar. Focused, consistent, and sharp. Not louder. Just better.

”I strongly believe in finding the exponential zone in order to grow. The zone where one has exponential value is often where passion, talent, money and doing good meet.”

That belief has become my compass. In the early days of my career, I was driven by status—like many businessmen are. But that shifted some years ago.

Today, it’s about doing things right, and doing them well. I’m wired to push, question, and raise the bar—not for the spotlight, but because excellence matters. And yeah, that kind of drive comes with a cost. The hours are long, the pressure’s real. But I’ve learned to welcome it. Because real leadership means showing up fully—even when it’s hard, especially when it’s hard.

A few years ago, I sold the company—not to step away, but to level up. We became part of Investment AB Spiltan’s Collaboration Art. It wasn’t a classic “Exit”—more like a Reset. A chance to reposition and scale the business in a smarter, stronger way. That shift opened up a new chapter. One that’s all about structure, direction, and unlocking the real potential of the group. That’s the work I’m doing now.

### Beyond the job and Personal

I didn’t become an entrepreneur for balance—I did it for freedom. The kind where you work your ass off, but on your own terms. And if you do it right—together with your team—you can change the direction of your family for generations. _**I believe in life balance.**_ Always have. But the whole “work-life balance” mantra? Never really bought into that—at least not for founders.

When I’m not working, I recharge through family (I’m Persian, so yeah—there’s a lot of family), padel, great food, and the kind of conversation that I can reflect over long after it ends. My wife—overly understanding of course (me being the always-on type and all)—and my son keep me on my toes, and remind me what really matters.

### What keeps me going?

It’s pretty straightforward: I work hard to lead in a way that helps people grow, to be part of something bigger than myself, and to do things properly—not just in business, but in how we treat each other.

That’s the life I’ve chosen—keep learning, keep building, keep moving. As a CEO, yes—but also as a husband, a dad, and just a person trying to get better. For the people close to me, for the society we’re part of, and for (all) the things we actually have the power to change.

# Meet Henrik Anderberg

I’m Henrik Anderberg, the EVP / Vice vd at GO MO Group, and also a partner at Collaboration Art, the parent company of GO MO Group. I operate primarily from our Gothenburg office, guiding the course of our team’s transformative journey in the exciting realm of B2B Commercial Excellence and Generative Ai.

Two unwavering beliefs fuel our journey: an obsessive pursuit of improvement and the understanding that success lies in the execution of strategies, rather than the strategies themselves.

Since 2023, I have been an active lecturer and inspirational speaker on Generative AI, collaborating with partners such as Västsvenska Handelskammaren, Företagarna, and Almi.

[![](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/henrik-image-1.webp)](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/henrik-image-1.webp "henrik-image-1")[![](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/henrik-image-2.webp)](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/henrik-image-2-601x1030.webp "henrik-image-2")[![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20872%201074'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/henrik-image-3-836x1030.webp "henrik-image-3")

With substantial experience in global B2B organizations, I focus on crafting successful digital marketing & sales strategies and teams that emphasize a high Return On Marketing Investment (ROMI). My academic credentials, including a BSc in Mechanical Engineering from Chalmers University of Technology and a BSc in Business Administration from the Gothenburg School of Business, further enrich my contributions to the team.

My journey with GO MO Group began as a client in 2017. I joined as a Client Success Manager (CSM) and progressed to become the Head of Client Success. Today, I hold the position of ECP and am part of the senior management team. In my role, I work closely with some of the largest industrial companies in the Nordics in combination with ambitious and growth-oriented SaaS clients. I often find myself functioning more like a management consultant than a project manager, guiding our clients not just in marketing, but also in brand, communication, sales, and business development strategies. We ensure steady, well-thought-out changes that are sustainable for the long term.

Personally, I see GO MO Group as a fantastic platform to experiment and bring ideas to life. As a knowledge enthusiast, I am constantly engaged in learning new ideas and gaining new perspectives. This curiosity extends to various mediums – from devouring podcasts to undertaking Masterclass lessons, and even running my own book summary project. Outside of work, I am an avid runner, having completed Göteborgsvarvet run in under 1:30, a personal achievement that brings me great pride. My thirst for learning extends to my personal life too, with travel being one of my favorite ways to explore new things. Join me on this exciting journey as we continue to grow and transform the field of digital marketing.

![Henrik Anderberg](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Henrik-landscape.jpg.webp)

### Henrik Anderberg

EVP / VICE VD

B2B commercial leader focused on real-world application of Generative AI across marketing and sales. Leads large-scale client transformation initiatives spanning Europe and India.

# Meet Ida

As a Project and Operations Coordinator, I am dedicated to optimizing our project execution and operational efficiency. My key responsibilities include:

**Project Management:** I oversee timelines and coordinate across teams to ensure that all projects meet their deadlines and align with client expectations. My role is crucial in managing the flow of information and resources to guarantee seamless project progression.

**Operational Support:** I am committed to enhancing operational processes to boost efficiency across the board. This includes managing office logistics, assisting with budget and financial tracking, and serving as a ”mood manager” at our Gothenburg office to ensure that all staff are content and well-equipped for their daily tasks.

**Team Collaboration:** I facilitate robust communication channels, coordinate travel and events for the team, support CEO logistics, and address project hurdles. My focus is on fostering a cohesive and productive environment that enhances team performance and project outcomes.

Since joining GO MO Group at its inception in 2012, I have played a pivotal role in the evolution of the company. My journey has allowed me to interact closely with every department, witnessing and contributing to the growth of our service offerings. This extensive experience, combined with my visits to our Pune office in India, has enriched my understanding and approach, enabling me to drive initiatives that support both our team’s welfare and our clients’ success.

### Education

Undergrad in business and administration and multiple certificates within Google tools like Analytics and Ads.

### About my role

Today, as a Project and Operations Coordinator, I continue to build on the foundational experiences I gained as one of the “first five” employees at our fast-growing company. This unique position has provided me with invaluable flexibility, allowing me to explore various roles that enhance customer value and expand our service offerings.

In my current role, I am responsible for overseeing project timelines and ensuring seamless coordination across teams, which is vital for meeting client expectations and deadlines. My efforts to streamline processes contribute significantly to our operational efficiency, managing everything from office logistics to budget tracking. I also take pride in maintaining a positive atmosphere at our Gothenburg office, ensuring that all staff are content and well-equipped for their tasks.

Additionally, my role involves fostering team collaboration. I facilitate communication, coordinate events and travels, support our CEO’s logistics, and address any project hurdles. These responsibilities are critical in maintaining a cohesive and productive team environment.

### Up close and personal

The phrase ”being married to your job” takes on a literal and figurative meaning for me. Not only am I married to GO MO’s founder and CEO, but I also share a deep and enduring commitment to the company. I am truly passionate about my role at GO MO and thrive on the challenges and growth opportunities it presents. Consequently, discussions about work often find their way to our dinner table, making GO MO not just my workplace but a significant part of our family’s lifestyle.

Outside of work, I cherish spending time with our son, and together as a family, we love to travel—embracing both long and short journeys whenever we can. While I love to travel and discover new places, I equally enjoy a sweaty workout class, dinners with good friends, or a quiet night at home with a great book or movie.

# Meet Lina

Vice President SME Strategy & Success

Lina joined GO MO Group in 2021 and has since carved a path from trainee to Vice President of SME Strategy and Success. Focused on strategy and driving top-line growth, she leads the SME segment like an agency manager, blending strategic vision with hands-on execution. Lina is dedicated to creating impactful value propositions, continuously learning, and pushing both her team and clients toward success.

### Education

- BSc in International Business from Gothenburg University School of Business, Economics and Law.
- MSc in Growth Management from Gothenburg University School of Business, Economics and Law.

### About My Role

As Vice President of SME Strategy and Success, my role is similar to that of an agency manager, leading the strategic development and growth of our SME segment. My responsibility is on increasing revenue, achieving our target gross margin, and continuously enhancing the value proposition of our offerings. It’s a blend of strategic vision and hands-on management – overseeing segment operations, driving initiatives that boost customer satisfaction, and making sure we deliver real impact. I have the responsibility and the privilege to allocate the right people to the right projects, and I am empowered to implement and refine internal processes and workflows that guarantee quality and efficiency.

What excites me most is working for our clients, staying engaged and driving the strategic improvements that help them succeed. I am also deeply involved in external education, facilitation, and project management within the realm of generative AI. This part of my role allows me to help clients harness advanced technologies to boost their efficiency, streamline operations, and ultimately increase their revenue per employee by freeing up time from administrative tasks. For me, it’s about blending strategy with action, and continuously finding ways to add value for both our clients and our team.

### What’s Essential for me to Making an Impact in the SME Segment

To make a real impact, I believe a few key elements are essential: trust from the organization, a skilled and supportive team, and the courage to embrace iteration and continuous learning. Developing a strong value proposition is central to what I do, but impactful results don’t happen overnight, it’s a journey that demands humility, patience, and constant refinement. Psychological safety plays a crucial role in this process, giving both me and my team the freedom to experiment, learn from mistakes, and adapt without fear of failure.

I’m deeply grateful for the trust our clients place in us, their feedback is invaluable in shaping our approach and pushing us to improve. This journey isn’t one I could take alone; it requires a dedicated team that consistently delivers high quality and clients who believe in what we’re building together. For me, success is about embracing change, continuously improving, and finding the right balance between strategic vision and hands-on execution. It’s this dynamic that moves us forward, allowing us to create something truly meaningful and effective in the SME segment.

### My Top 3 Priorities

**From a Company Perspective:** My main focus is on creating a scalable SME offering that truly enhances our clients’ digital presence and delivers measurable business outcomes. To achieve this, I need to deeply understand the SME landscape and be ready to adapt our strategies as the market evolves. It’s about staying ahead, ensuring our offerings not only meet but exceed client expectations, and drive growth.

**From My Personal Perspective:** For me, it’s all about building trust and creating an environment where psychological safety is a given. I believe that when we feel safe to express our ideas, challenge each other, and learn from every experience, that’s when the magic happens. I strive to foster a culture where iteration is encouraged and continuous improvement is part of our DNA. It’s important to me that my team and I can grow together, delivering value through every interaction.

**From an SME Segment Perspective:** SMEs need practical, action-oriented strategies that address their real-world challenges, especially when it comes to driving sales and growth. My goal is to ensure our solutions are not just innovative but also grounded in reality, empowered by Generative AI but always tailored to what our clients truly need. It’s about making sure our approach evolves with feedback, staying relevant, and ultimately making a positive impact on their business journey.

### Looking Forward

As I look ahead, my focus is on driving growth and making a real impact within the SME segment. This role is about more than just refining strategies; it’s about building something sustainable and scalable that truly delivers results. With the responsibility of managing our budget, I am committed to optimizing our resources and making strategic choices that support our growth journey. By embracing advanced digital strategies and leveraging generative AI, I aim to empower our clients in ways that genuinely drive their success.

I’m excited about the opportunities this role offers – it’s a chance to deepen my leadership skills, explore my entrepreneurial instincts, and gain valuable insights into what it takes to build, manage, and scale a business. I see this as a door-opener, not just for the company but for my own growth as well. My goal is to contribute meaningfully to the financial success of GO MO Group and leave a positive mark on our clients, the SME segment, and the entire organization.

### Up Close and Personal

I live by the philosophy that nothing is impossible, and that the only thing holding you back is your attitude towards life. Reciprocity is at the heart of everything I do—what you give, you get back, and this belief drives me to constantly develop and push myself. For as long as I can remember (and as my family often reminds me), I’ve been eager to try new things, learn, and explore. This curiosity fuels my love for travel; being in new places, meeting diverse people, and exchanging ideas provide me with fresh perspectives and endless inspiration. I thrive on the energy of movement and discovery—sitting still has never been my thing.

Whether it’s sharing a great conversation over a meal or connecting with someone on a run, I find joy in the exchange of experiences. You’ll often find me at one of Gothenburg’s restaurants enjoying good food and wine – another passion of mine – or working out at Barry’s, hitting the running trail, or diving into a new DIY project, like my latest obsession with reupholstering furniture. These moments keep me energized, grounded, and always ready for the next adventure. For me, it’s all about engaging with the world, learning from every opportunity, and always striving to be the best version of myself.

# Meet Puja

I am GO MO’s User Experience Manager. I lead the Design and Development departments from the office in Pune, India. At heart, I have always been a problem solver who believes that great customer experience can be achieved through the magic of design.

### Education

Bachelors in journalism and mass communication from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi.

### About my role

I joined GO MO Group in 2016. I have had the opportunity to build and lead a team of designers and developers in producing digital products.

In my 8 years of leading design engagements, I’ve designed UI/UX strategies that operate in tandem with digital marketing for both B2B and B2C customers. I believe that a combination of user-centric design, effective stakeholder management, and digital marketing knowledge can bring about the best solutions for any digital product.

### Up close and personal

Curiosity and creative expression are the two mantras I live by. Because of this, I spend my free time indulging in my many hobbies and interests: reading fiction and history books, painting, writing, learning new languages, and making music, to name a few. Although I love meeting new people and traveling to new places, I feel equally joyous when I complete a painting or write a song alone in my room.

![Puja Kumari](https://www.gomogroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Puja-GO-MO-300-600.png.webp)

### Puja Kumari

Vice Managing Director

UX design lead with deep experience in digital design and user experience. Puja‘s teams provide design mockups and analysis on improving user journey, and develops our client’s websites.

# Meet Rickard

Hello, I’m Rickard Koskenniemi, spearheading the copywriting division at GO MO Group. Operating from our Gothenburg office, I’m immersed in writing and refining our content creation process, utilizing LLMs like ChatGPT and Bard.

### My Journey at GO MO Group

Since joining GO MO Group in 2018 as an intern and later progressing to a full-time copywriter, I’ve now stepped into the role of Automated Copywriting Lead. I collaborate with experts from top industrial and SaaS companies in the Nordics, creating compelling content and advising our clients’ internal content writers on SEO and content creation.

GO MO Group is a hub of innovation, where we constantly challenge conventional approaches to harness new technologies and methodologies. It is a playground where I can test the newest technologies, improve my content writing skills, and exchange and discuss the marketing industry as a whole with like minded people.

When I’m not crafting content, I’m an enthusiastic gamer, exploring a wide array of games from World of Warcraft and Diablo, to the Dark Souls franchise and Noita(Finnish Roguelike, I highly recommend checking it out!). My interest in computers and emerging technologies, especially the transformative world of Generative AI, keeps me excited about the future prospects of my role and the evolution of GO MO Group.

Join me on this exhilarating path as we continue to innovate and redefine the landscape of marketing and content creation.

### My Journey with Generative AI

My journey in B2B content creation has been extensive, and now I’m venturing into innovative uses of Generative AI to elevate our services:

**Strategy:** Our strategy is meticulously crafted to align with your business objectives. By integrating Generative AI, we not only enhance the quality and speed of content production but also ensure it’s dynamic and engaging, perfectly resonating with your company’s ethos.

**Structure:** The structure of our agency is designed for maximum flexibility and adaptability. We harness the power of Generative AI to streamline our solutions, tailor-made for your specific SEO and content creation requirements. This approach enhances both the relevance and appeal of the content we produce.

**System:** We utilize advanced systems for comprehensive SEO management, encompassing in-depth keyword analysis and robust analytics. The incorporation of Generative AI guarantees precision and efficiency in our campaigns, enabling us to produce content that is not only innovative but also deeply resonates with your target audience.

**Expertise:** The team at GO MO Group consists of unmatched SEO experts, deeply versed in both Generative AI and content creation. We focus on crafting content that is not only optimized for search engines but also meaningfully engages your audience, solidifying your online presence and providing a significant competitive edge.

**State-of-the-Art Workflow:** Our content creation is revolutionized by fully leveraging Generative AI. This approach keeps us at the forefront, maximizing both productivity and creativity. We blend this advanced technology with our team’s creative prowess to produce content that meets SEO standards while also captivating and resonating with your audience. This method ensures your content not only ranks well but also bolsters your brand’s authority, driving measurable improvements in engagement and conversions.

# Meet Safa

I’m Safa, managing director of GO MO Group in India. I’ve been stationed at our Pune office since 2013, and love to be able to work closely with our teams of specialists. I have always been an entrepreneur, and have previously worked in São Paulo, Brazil, and Gurgaon, India.

### Education

MSc in International Business and Management from the University of Manchester and a BSc in Business Administration with an emphasis in Management from California State University: Long Beach.

### About my role

I have a passion for international business and marketing. When I got the chance to combine these two at GO MO Group, I immediately jumped at the opportunity. I believe that a team with the right coordination and leadership can achieve things way above any individual’s capacity. My position between the Swedish and Indian offices makes me a key player in enabling our respective teams to perform at their best.

### Up close and personal

In my free time, I enjoy reading books on personal growth, and I am a true foodie – the only thing that can make good company better is good food. Especially if this combination happens to coincide with a win for Chelsea FC.
